Title: Darkness in the Brightwood
Description: Yonas recalls a priest named Brother Umberto who once ministered to the Soulwardens. The two of you decide to seek out Umberto in the town of Walsham in Brightwood and learn his fate.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />Yes, we must find allies as well. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />We needn't repeat the failed experiment of doing this alone.
InProgressResponse: <g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> There is no more for us here. <g id="male_gesturebackthere" priority="high" />Meet me at the Shadowmine Shrine.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />It appears the town fell to the Lost primarily from within, <g id="male_converseleft" />no signs of any defense.

Title: The Shining Knight
Description: On the trail of Brother Umberto, you and Yonas have decided to head west, where the priest apparently went to request assistance from the knight, Ser Galahad.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Hm. Some say King Artorius fell during the war, others say he fled, <g id="male_nodunderstand" />and there were even whispers that he turned.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_gestureRight" priority="high" />Go on your way then, young Soulwarden. I will be along soon enough.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_spreadarms001" />I welcome your aid for Umberto's sake, but I did<g id="litearmor_shakehead" /> not realize you were a Soulwarden.

Title: Losing the Faith
Description: Investigate Staudt's Manor and Kalterstein Cemetery for more clues about Umberto and then meet Galahad and Yonas at the shrine to the north.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />Nothing to explain how this entire region fell to the Lost… <g id="female_handsonhipsshakeheadS" priority="high" />just horrific stories as so many succumbed to despair.
InProgressResponse: Go on then. We both have a duty to perform.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You have arrived just in time, young Soulwarden. <g id="male_willcoverit" />I was becoming quite concerned.

Title: Crimson Menace
Description: Yonas has discovered that the Corrupted have claimed several resource locations in Brightwood, including a massive iron mine. You need to investigate if they have an ulterior motive in seizing the mine and then meet Yonas in the town of Calvary.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_handsforwardRequest" />That is what you must investigate. I suggest you start in the mine. <g id="female_nodyes" />It could very well be something buried here.
InProgressResponse: Go on. I will meet you in the town of Calvary.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I was on the verge of going to search for you… to apologize. <g id="male_apologize" />I doubted both you and the old man, but I was wrong.

Title: The Gates of Great Cleave
Description: Yonas is scouting out the Corrupted presence in Great Cleave where he has asked that you join him and formulate a strategy for driving the enemy out of Brightwood.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_disappointed" priority="high" />The old man has more courage than good sense - <g id="female_whattheheck" />he's gone to ascertain whether the Corrupted have a presence in Great Cleave.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />Be wary out there, my friend. It seems <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />nowhere outside these town walls is truly safe.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_gesturebackthere" />I saw Yonas in the tavern - he's recruiting new Soulwardens and <g id="litearmor_shakehead" />entertaining some dream of claiming Caer Dun for the Order.

Title: The Vigil’s Truth
Description: Galahad has reached an impasse in the investigation into what happened to Umberto and the Bright Vigil. It's decided that you will speak with Mayor Pennyfather and follow up on any hints he's willing to share.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_nodUnderstand" />I did speak with the Mayor… a bit nervous that one. <g id="male_think" />Are you suggesting he's hiding something from me?
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />If you learn anything definitive about Umberto, make sure to let me know.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_bowShallow" />Greetings, young Warden. I understand <g id="male_complimentplayer" />you left town after speaking with Pennyfather.

Title: Betrayal at Brightrest
Description: Mayor Tunstall Pennyfather admitted that he was aware of the Bright Vigil's atrocities and the curse that followed. After discussing with Galahad and the Master Alchemist Sun Fuchun, it becomes clear where the trail leads next.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_nodyes" />Very well, then I will leave you <g id="male_complimentplayer" />to follow the trail wherever it leads.
InProgressResponse: <g id="female_handsonhipsShakehead" priority="high" />If everything Pennyfather says is true, Umberto has horrific crimes to answer for…Unless he too has fallen Lost.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_takeItem5s" priority="high"/>Ah, you got the Bright Sigils? Amazing. <g id="male_complimentplayer" />I can't express how good it feels to have an ally in this effort - <g id="female_nodshrugokay" />especially one who can fight!

Title: The Azoth Tree
Description: In order to cleanse the curse from Caer Dun, Sun Fuchun needs Sacred Waters collected from the Azoth Tree in the nearby grove, but it's necessary to acquire vessels from the Shamans in the neighboring caverns in order to extract the waters. After collecting the waters, rejoin Sun Fuchun.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_male_headnodyes" />Yes, but I'm <g id="male_explain" />not so keen on that wording. The so-called "Angry Earth" evolved from a deep and primal power.
InProgressResponse: The tree is invested with vast power. Step lightly in the grove.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_think" bout="1.5"/>The alchemist is clearly gifted in some vestal fashion - you've done <g id="male_nodunderstand" />well partnering with her.

Title: Umberto’s Sentence
Description: Galahad has tracked Umberto to Vigil's Stand and it's now time to confront the fallen priest, acquire his Heartgem and then rejoin Galahad at the Postrekhin Shrine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_crossarmsSuspicious" />Did he? I will refrain from commenting on that practice out of respect, <g id="female_nodyes" />but Umberto must be called to answer for his crimes.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_compliment" />You're a brave soul to undertake this endeavor. <g id="female_headshakeSmall" />Umberto has become a monster.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_sighRelief" />It is done, then? The tragic tale of the once-brave Brother Umberto <g id="male_nodunderstand" />finally draws to a close.

Title: The Curse of Caer Dun
Description: Working with Ser Galahad, you've defeated Grand Vigilant Umberto and taken his Heartgem. All that remains is to return to Caer Dun and follow Sun Fuchun's instructions for removing the curse.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />I will return to Calvary and seek other ways I can help restore the Brightwood.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I will give your offer due consideration, my friend. <g id="male_bowShallow" />Until then, good fortune to you at Caer Dun.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_complimentplayer" />You've done well, young one. <g id="female_pointRight" />As menacing as that Corrupted army in Great Cleave may be, <g id="female_nodyes" />I believe we are safe here.

Title: The Corpse Crone
Description: Following the vision you received from the Azoth Tree, you've decided to search for the sorceress with the purple eye. You must revisit Mayor Tunstall Pennyfather in Calvary and then meet Galahad on the road to Weaver's Fen.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_shrugnothingicando" />It means you have been imbued with a power that exceeds my understanding, <g id="female_leanpointconvince" />and it makes you both a target and a threat to the enemy.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_willcoverit" />I believe in you, and if you need me, I will be here.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_sighRelief" />You've heard Pennyfather's sordid tale, have you? I do not give that man's story much credence.
